items.title: The 5 PM Task Drop
items.premise: Boss assigns a massive report right as the employee is putting on their jacket to leave. The employee dramatically clocks out in slow motion while staring deadpan into Boss's soul. Punchline: The boss finds out the next morning the file was just a blank document titled 'Happy Thursday'.

items.title: The Silent Printer Rebellion
items.premise: An office printer jams on the single most important page right before a board meeting. Coworker tries to fix it by whispering gentle threats to the machine. Punchline: The printer spits out 50 blank pages only after the meeting has already ended.

items.title: The Tupperware Ransom Note
items.premise: Mom discovers a missing high-end Tupperware container from last month's potluck and launches a full CSI-style investigation in the living house. Dad tries to frame the family dog. Punchline: The Tupperware is found in the freezer, completely full of ice cubes.

items.title: Grandma's Bluetooth Confusion
items.premise: Grandma tries to connect her hearing aid to the living room smart TV to watch her soap opera in absolute peace. Instead, she accidentally hijacks Dad's heavy metal workout playlist at full blast. Punchline: Grandma starts headbanging while sipping her chamomile tea.

items.title: The Menu Speedrun
items.premise: A nervous dater spends two hours memorizing the entire menu to sound cultured on a first date, only for the date to order plain chicken nuggets. Punchline: The date says, 'I actually can't read, I just wanted to see if you'd panic.'

items.title: The Third Wheel's Tactical Retreat
items.premise: Bestfriend agrees to chaperone a couple's anniversary dinner to catch up on gossip, but ends up acting as a human privacy screen during a minor disagreement. Punchline: Bestfriend charges the couple a $20 consulting fee for relationship therapy.

items.title: The Group Chat Hall of Shame
items.premise: Student checks the school project group chat at 2 AM to find zero work done except for 400 random cat memes sent by the slacker teammate. Punchline: The teacher assigns individual grades based on contribution, instantly ending the slacker's career.

items.title: The Exam Pencil Heist
items.premise: Student realizes they forgot a pencil right before a major pop quiz and initiates a silent black-market trade across the classroom. Punchline: They successfully acquire a 0.5mm mechanical pencil like a spy escaping a bank vault, only to realize it has no lead inside.

items.title: The Subscription Graveyard
items.premise: Broke adult tries to cancel a tiny $3 monthly fitness app subscription, but the app forces them through a digital obstacle course of emotional guilt trips and fake crying avatars. Punchline: They accidentally upgrade to the VIP annual plan out of sheer panic.

items.title: The Instant Ramen Gourmet Hour
items.premise: To save money until payday, Broke Adult tries to cook instant ramen like a fancy 5-star Michelin chef using sheer delusion and random pantry condiments. Punchline: It still tastes exactly like instant chicken sodium packets, but now it costs twice as much in electricity.

items.title: The Accidental Umbrella Swap
items.premise: An annoyed commuter grabs what they think is their plain black umbrella from the office rack, only to find it covered in bright yellow duckling stickers. Punchline: The owner of the duck umbrella catches them outside and smiles so warmly that the commuter throws away their old umbrella forever.

items.title: The Lost Wallet Trap
items.premise: A stressed teen finds a dropped wallet stuffed with cash on a park bench and debates whether to become a secret agent millionaire or do the right thing. Punchline: They return it to the owner, who turns out to be their strict school principal—who rewards them by canceling tomorrow's pop quiz.
